messages.content: 在標準牌組中獲得一張面牌的機率是多少？

function.name: probability_coin_toss_heads
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a specific number of heads after tossing a coin multiple times. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

coin_tosses.description: The number of times the coin is tossed.

heads_needed.description: The specific number of heads you want to get after coin tosses.

coin_type.description: The type of the coin. Default is 'fair'. Possible values are 'fair', 'double_heads', 'double_tails'.

message.content:
在一副標準的 52 張牌（四種花色，每種 13 張）中，面牌（J、Q、K）共有 12 張。  
單次抽牌得到面牌的機率為：

\[
P(\text{面牌})=\frac{12}{52}=\frac{3}{13}\approx 0.2308 \quad (\text{約 }23.1\%)
\]

如果你想知道多次抽牌或其他條件下的機率，請告訴我具體情況！
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "在標準牌組中獲得一張面牌的機率是多少？" Means: "What is the probability of drawing a face card from a standard deck?" They want the probability of getting a face card (Jack, Queen, King). In a standard 52-card deck, there are 12 face cards (4 Jacks, 4 Queens, 4 Kings). So probability = 12/52 = 3/13 ≈ 0.2308 or about 23.08%. The user didn't specify if they want a single draw or multiple draws. Likely single draw. So answer: 12/52 = 3/13 ≈ 23.1%.

We can also mention if it's a single draw. Provide the fraction and decimal.

Thus answer: 3/13 ≈ 0.2308.
